newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Benicia, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
1997 General Obligation Wastewater Bonds, Series A

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code, that the City Council of the City of Benicia, California, invites bids for the purchase of $5,000,000 aggregate principal amount of City of Benicia (Solano County, California) 1997 General Obligation

at 10:00 A.M., at the office of Jones Hall, A Professional Law Corporation, Four Embarcadero Center, 19th Floor, San Francisco, California 94111, and the sale will be awarded by the Finance Director or Assistant Finance Director of the City within 26 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of bids. The sale of the Bonds will be conducted upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Official Notice of Sale for the Bonds. Such Official Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement describing the Bonds will be distributed to prospective bidders by the financial advisor to the City, Bartle Wells Associates, 1636 Bush Street, San Francisco, California 94109, telephone (415) 775-3113. Bids will be entertained only from bidders to whom such Official Notice of Sale and Preliminary Official Statement have been distributed.
